essence: A supreme unrevealable secret bestows fulfillment of all desires
The secret is applied in the accomplishment of duty, wealth, desire, and liberation
The speech-seed protects the head and the love-king protects the heart
Bālā with the syllables aiṃ, klīṃ, sauḥ protects the face for all accomplishment
Sundarī protects the navel region and Kāmakalā always protects the head
